items.exampleEn: The novelist writes for four hours every morning.
items.exampleZh: 那位小說家每天早上寫作四小時。

items.exampleEn: This animated series is popular with children.
items.exampleZh: 這部動畫影集很受小朋友歡迎。

items.exampleEn: My grandfather calls his small garden his paradise.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺把他的小花園稱為他的天堂。

items.exampleEn: The comedian made the whole room laugh.
items.exampleZh: 那位喜劇演員讓全場哈哈大笑。

items.exampleEn: We usually eat outdoors in summer.
items.exampleZh: 夏天我們通常在戶外吃飯。

items.exampleEn: She studied animation and now works for a film company.
items.exampleZh: 她念動畫，現在在一家電影公司工作。

items.exampleEn: Many people get a lot of enjoyment from music.
items.exampleZh: 很多人從音樂中得到許多樂趣。

items.exampleEn: He has worked as an entertainer on cruise ships for years.
items.exampleZh: 他在郵輪上當表演者已經好幾年了。

items.sentenceEn: My favorite novelist has a new book out.
items.sentenceZh: 我最喜歡的小說家出了一本新書。

items.audioEn: The comedian's show starts at nine, but the doors open at eight.
items.audioZh: 那位喜劇演員的表演九點開始，但八點開放入場。

items.sentenceEn: Children should play outdoors every day.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們每天都應該到戶外玩。

items.sentenceEn: The animation in this film took three years to make.
items.sentenceZh: 這部電影的動畫花了三年製作。

items.stemEn: The party ____ sang, danced, and did magic tricks.
items.stemZh: 那位派對表演者又唱又跳，還表演魔術。

items.stemEn: In ____ films, the characters are drawn, not played by real actors.
items.stemZh: 在動畫電影裡，角色是畫出來的，不是由真人演員演出。

items.passageEn: My cousin Kai works in animation. He draws characters for animated films at a small studio. Before that, he wanted to be a novelist, but he found more enjoyment in drawing. On weekends, he goes outdoors to draw people in the park. Last month, his studio made a short film about a comedian who travels to an island resort that looks like paradise. A famous entertainer even sang a song for the film. Kai says his job is hard but a lot of fun.
items.passageZh: 我表親 Kai 從事動畫工作。他在一間小工作室為動畫電影畫角色。在那之前，他想當小說家，但他發現畫畫更有樂趣。週末時，他會到戶外，在公園畫人。上個月，他的工作室做了一部短片，講一位喜劇演員到一個像天堂的島上度假村旅行。一位有名的藝人還為這部片唱了一首歌。Kai 說他的工作很辛苦，但充滿樂趣。

questions.questionZh: 上個月的短片在講什麼？
options: 一位喜劇演員去度假村的故事

items.promptZh: 這座小島對愛釣魚的人來說是天堂。
referenceEn: This island is a paradise for people who love fishing.
For people who love fishing, this island is paradise.
rubricZh: paradise 表示「天堂、樂園」，例如 a paradise for… 等說法
時態配合內容（多用現在簡單式）

items.promptZh: 下雨並沒有減少我們看煙火的樂趣。
referenceEn: The rain did not reduce our enjoyment of the fireworks.
The rain didn't spoil our enjoyment of the fireworks.
rubricZh: 用 enjoyment 表示「樂趣」（例如 our enjoyment of…）
「沒有減少」可寫，例如 did not reduce、did not spoil 等
